purpose: Mechanically audited static contract for the runtime selector-to-record manager reached by the focused 5937 dispatch closure.

source.independent_projects: project-a and project-b decompilation/listing/data outputs matched

contract.name: manage_dispatch_record_selector_05A0
contract.calling_convention: far; selector at [BP+0x06]; RETF 0x2; AX returns the current selector mapping
contract.inputs_outputs: Calls 0227:05CD with AX=0x0006, calls 01F7:0931(selector), scans candidates 0..0x018f inclusive as DS:6D8A records with 0x2c-byte stride, replaces DS:6D8E[selector] with the first record whose resource pointers at +0x10/+0x12 are both zero, and returns DS:6D8E[selector]. If no record is free, the existing mapping remains unchanged.
global_writes: DS:6D8E[selector] when a free record is found
contract.scheduler_position: Dispatch/resource-record management before a later 5937/386F record callback; no direct player-callback invocation
contract.object_effects: May release the selector's prior runtime record through 01F7:0931 and changes the runtime selector map; record resource contents and far callback pointers are data-driven.
contract.feeds_back_into_simulation: indirectly; selector remapping can affect later auxiliary dispatch, but no player-record or callback-global simulation write is direct

callees.name: reload_transition_delay_tick_0931
callees.flags: selector word; clears mapped record resource pointers and restores DS:6D8E[selector]=FFFF

runtime_boundary.records: DS:6D8A runtime far-pointer table; each record is 0x2c bytes
unresolved: resource ownership beyond the 0931 cleanup contract
